description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Acquisition of the Land Karandeniya D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the compensation deposit for a specific land parcel (Lawlugahawatta) with full property description including name, plan number, lot number, extent, and boundaries. The content focuses solely on land/property administrative matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
